label: Has raised horde
summary: Whether the character has raised a horde.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD, where it shows or hides parts of the interface, also in a negated form. A yes/no check on a character. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has raised regiments
summary: Whether the character has raised their regiments (their armies called up).
details: Vanilla uses it in the HUD: the raise/disband armies button is shown when the character is at war and has not raised regiments (the button's click raises all regiments). The game documents nothing more.

label: Has realm law
summary: A check that takes one value, apparently whether the character's realm has a given law.
details: Going by its name and one use in a realm tooltip text, this is a check on a character. The game does not register its return type, so what it hands back is not documented.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The law being asked about (not documented).

label: Has regnal name
summary: Whether the character has a regnal name (a ruler's name with a number, like 'Henry II').
details: Going by its name and its use to show or hide a part of a tooltip, this is a yes/no check on a character. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has relation to
summary: Whether the character has some relation to the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the tax collector window (it is called with the player and decides what is shown), this is a yes/no check. Which kinds of relation count is not documented.

label: Has royal court
summary: Whether the character has a royal court.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD, where it controls whether a part of it shows; one use pairs it with a flag for whether the player has ever opened the royal court. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Has seal coat of arms
summary: Whether the character has a seal coat of arms.
details: Going by its name and its use in the coat of arms parts of the interface (shown or hidden, also together with a valid house), this is a yes/no check on a character. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has sexuality
summary: A yes/no check on a character about sexuality; the game documents nothing more.
details: The input shows no use of it on a character. The only lines with the same name belong to the ruler designer window, where it is called with a value like 'none' or 'heterosexual'; that is a hint only, so how it works on a character is not known.

label: Has static modifier
summary: Whether the character has the given static modifier.
details: Going by its name and one use in the situation list (called on a story's owner with a static modifier), this is a yes/no check. The game documents nothing more.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The static modifier to look for.

label: Has suzerain
summary: Whether the character has a suzerain.
details: Going by its name and its use in the map icons and a realm tooltip, this is a yes/no check on a character. The game does not register its return type, so this is read from how it is used.

label: Has tax slots
summary: Whether the character has tax slots (places to assign vassals as tax payers).
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD, where it decides whether parts of it are shown or enabled (one use pairs it with a count of unassigned vassals), this is a yes/no check on a character.

label: Has timed modifier
summary: Whether the character has the given timed modifier.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has trait
summary: Whether the character has the given trait.
details: Going by its name and its use in the ledger and the situation window (called with a trait), this is a yes/no check on a character.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a trait, e.g. Trait.Self or GetTrait('key')

label: Has trait by key
summary: Whether the character has the trait with the given key.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. It looks like a sibling of 'has trait' that takes the trait's key. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has trait from group
summary: Whether the character has any trait from the given trait group.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has treasury
summary: Whether the character has a treasury.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window and the ledger (shown or hidden), this is a yes/no check on a character. Another line combines it with a count of diplomacy items.

label: Has truce
summary: Whether the character has a truce; it takes one value, probably the other party.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use, and who the argument is is a guess from the name. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has unpressed claim on title
summary: Whether the character holds an unpressed claim on the given title.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has vassal info
summary: A yes/no check on a character, apparently whether vassal information is available; the game documents nothing more.
details: The name is all there is: the input shows no use.

label: Has vassals
summary: Whether the character has vassals.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD (shows or hides a part of it), this is a yes/no check on a character.

label: Holds court position
summary: Whether the character holds a court position.
details: Going by its name only. The one line with the same name calls it on the owner of a court in the court positions window, which is a hint at most.

label: Hook tooltip
summary: The tooltip text about the hooks involving this character.
details: Going by its name and its use as the tooltip of character lists and portraits, it returns text shown when hovering. What exactly it says is not documented.

label: Is acclaimed knight
summary: Whether the character is an acclaimed knight.
details: Going by its name and its use in the accolade and knights windows: the knights window shows a view when the character is an acclaimed knight or a knight, and the accolade window disables something when it is true and picks between the texts CANNOT_FORBID_ACCLAIMED_KNIGHT and KNIGHTS_VIEW_TITLE_FORBID_TT. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is accolade successor
summary: Whether the character is the successor of an accolade.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is adult
summary: Whether the character is an adult.
details: Going by its name and its use in merit examination texts, where it is combined with other checks. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is alive
summary: Whether the character is alive.
details: Vanilla uses it to pick between two texts: a living character gets one tooltip or message, a dead one another (for example 'Nothing notable has happened yet...' against 'These memories are lost to time...').

label: Is assigned as taxpayer
summary: Whether the character is assigned as a tax payer in a tax slot.
details: Going by its name and its use in the tax slot assignment window and character lists (shown or hidden). A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is at war
summary: Whether the character is at war.
details: Vanilla uses it in the HUD and the outliner. In the HUD it is paired with 'has raised regiments': the raise/disband armies button shows when the character is at war with no regiments raised.

label: Is average fertility between
summary: Whether the character's average fertility lies between two numbers.
details: Vanilla uses it in the migration window with the ranges 0.0 to 0.3, 0.3 to 0.6 and 0.6 to 1.1, in three separate parts of the window. Which end counts as inside is not documented.

label: Is away
summary: Whether the character is away.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. Compare 'is away from home', which vanilla does use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is away from home
summary: Whether the character is away from their home.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD and portraits: vanilla combines it with 'not traveling' (and, in the HUD, an activity that is missing or complete) to decide whether something is shown.

label: Is baron or unlanded
summary: Whether the character is a baron or has no land.
details: Going by its name and its use in character lists, where it is one of several conditions for showing or hiding an entry (together with a herder government check).

label: Is bastard
summary: Whether the character is a bastard.
details: Going by its name and its use in the dynasty tree window, this is a yes/no check on a character.

label: Is betrothed
summary: Whether the character is betrothed.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is court language
summary: Whether the given culture pillar (language) is the court language of the character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the languages window, where a negated check hides something. The argument there is a culture pillar. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is clergy
summary: Whether the character is a member of the clergy.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window, where it is combined with 'is ruler' to show a view for clergy rulers. Portraits also use it.

label: Is commanding army
summary: Whether the character is commanding an army.
details: Vanilla uses it in the 'away from home' tooltip: it picks the line 'Commanding <army>' as against 'Serving as a knight in <army>'.

label: Is concubine
summary: Whether the character is a concubine.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window, where a negated check is combined with 'is not the player'. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is council task valid
summary: Whether the given council task can be done in the given place.
details: Going by its name only. The one use with the same name is called on the player with the task 'task_fabricate_claim' and a county's capital, which is a hint at most, not proof for this type.

label: Is councillor
summary: Whether the character is a councillor.
details: Going by its name and its use in the window for choosing a councillor, where it shows or hides parts of a list entry. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is count or above
summary: Whether the character holds a rank of count or higher.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is dead and valid
summary: Whether the character is dead and still a valid character entry.
details: Going by its name and its use in the outliner and the ledger (shown or hidden, also negated). 'Valid' here means the entry points to a real character; the exact meaning is not documented.

label: Is diarch able
summary: Whether the character is able to be a diarch.
details: Going by its name only. The one line with the same name asks it of the displayed diarch in the diarchy window, which is a hint at most.

label: Is diarch of
summary: Whether the character is the diarch of the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window and portraits, where it is called with the character's liege.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The ruler the diarch would serve.

label: Is dynast
summary: Whether the character is a dynast.
details: Going by its name and its use in the house window, this is a yes/no check on a character. How it relates to 'is dynasty head' is not documented.

label: Is dynasty head
summary: Whether the character is the head of their dynasty.
details: Going by its name and its use in the dynasty tree window, where it is combined with 'is founder of dynasty' and 'is house head'.

label: Is employed in position by
summary: Whether the character holds the given court position at the given ruler's court.
details: Going by its name and its use in the chariot race widgets, where it is called with the player and the 'charioteer_court_position' type. A yes/no check.

label: Is favorite child of
summary: Whether the character is the favorite child of the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in portraits, where it is called with the player. A yes/no check.

label: Is female
summary: Whether the character is female.
details: Vanilla uses it to write the sex in a tooltip: it picks 'Female' or 'Male'. It also switches parts of the character window.

label: Is founder of dynasty
summary: Whether the character founded their dynasty.
details: Going by its name and its use in the dynasty tree window, where it is compared with the dynasty being shown, and used negated together with 'is dynasty head'.

label: Is governor
summary: Whether the character is a governor.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is guest
summary: Whether the character is a guest at a court.
details: Going by its name and its use in the court, councillor and accolade windows: for a guest one text shows the guest description instead of the relation to the player.

label: Is hireable ruler
summary: Whether the character is a ruler that can be hired.
details: Going by its name and its use in the military window, where it is combined with a check that the hire-mercenaries interaction is valid. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is hireable ruler available
summary: Whether the character is a hireable ruler who is available for hire.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is hired by local player
summary: Whether the character is a hireable ruler currently employed by the local player.
details: Going by its name and its use in the military window (shown or hidden). The local player is the human player on this computer.

label: Is hostage
summary: Whether the character is a hostage.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window, where it shows or hides parts of the window, also negated.

label: Is house head
summary: Whether the character is the head of their house.
details: Going by its name and its use in the dynasty tree window and portraits. The dynasty tree pairs it with 'not dynasty head'; portraits pair it with a powerful house and a vassal check.

label: Is hovered
summary: Whether the mouse is currently over this character's portrait or entry.
details: Going by its name and its use in the activity window, where it makes something visible while a character is hovered, or highlighted by an event window. It is an interface check, not a game fact.

label: Is imprisoned
summary: Whether the character is imprisoned.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD, the map icons and the activity window. The HUD pairs a negated check with 'courtier wants to leave court' to decide whether something shows.

label: Is in a faction
summary: Whether the character is a member of a faction.
details: Going by its name only. The one line with the same name calls it on the player in the HUD, together with 'is landed ruler' and 'has liege', which is a hint at most.

label: Is in faction against player
summary: Whether the character is in a faction that targets the player.
details: Going by its name and its use in the outliner, where it is paired with 'is my powerful vassal'.

label: Is incapable
summary: Whether the character is incapable.
details: Going by its name and its use in portraits (three show/hide uses). A tooltip text in the game about the 'incapable' trait says such a character cannot take actions independently; that is a hint that this check is related, not proof. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is independent ruler
summary: Whether the character is an independent ruler.
details: Going by its name and its use in the vassal detail and domicile windows, where it is used negated and with 'is local player'. A yes/no check on a character.

label: Is knight
summary: Whether the character is a knight.
details: Going by its name and its use in the accolade and knights windows, where it shows a view or fades a row (alpha 1.0 for a knight, 0.6 otherwise).

label: Is knight by default
summary: Whether the character counts as a knight by default (not by a forced or forbidden choice).
details: Going by its name and its use as a button state ('down') in the accolade and knights windows, next to the 'forced' and 'disallowed' checks. The game does not register its return type.

label: Is knight disallowed
summary: Whether the character has been disallowed from being a knight.
details: Going by its name and its use as a button state ('down') in the accolade and knights windows, next to the 'default' and 'forced' checks. The game does not register its return type.

label: Is knight forced
summary: Whether the character has been forced to be a knight.
details: Going by its name and its use as a button state ('down') in the accolade and knights windows, next to the 'default' and 'disallowed' checks. The game does not register its return type.

label: Is knight in army
summary: Whether the character is a knight serving in an army.
details: Vanilla uses it in the 'away from home' tooltips (together with 'is commanding army') and in the window for choosing an army commander.

label: Is knight in given army
summary: Whether the character is a knight serving in the given army.
details: Going by its name and its use in the army commander window, where it is called with the army shown there.

label: Is landed ruler
summary: Whether the character is a ruler who holds land.
details: Going by its name only. The one line with the same name calls it on the player in the HUD, together with 'is in a faction' and 'has liege', which is a hint at most.

label: Is landless ruler
summary: Whether the character is a ruler without land.
details: Going by its name and its use in the map icons and the migration window. The map icon use also checks a lobby-pin setting of the domicile.

label: Is legitimate house member
summary: Whether the character is a legitimate member of their house.
details: Going by its name and its use, always negated, in the character window, a tooltip and the multiplayer lobby, where it hides or shows something for those who are not.

label: Is legitimized bastard
summary: Whether the character is a bastard who has been legitimized.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is local player
summary: Whether the character is the one played by the human at this computer.
details: Vanilla uses it to pick wording: texts say 'are' for the local player and 'is' for anyone else. It is used very widely, for example in merit and tooltip texts.

label: Is merit capped
summary: Whether the character has reached a merit cap.
details: Going by its name and its use in merit texts and the HUD, where it is combined with 'can improve merit rank', 'is adult' and a test that the merit level is not 9.

label: Is my powerful vassal
summary: Whether the character is a powerful vassal of the player.
details: Going by its name and its use in the outliner, the tournament widget and portraits. The outliner pairs it with 'not in a faction targeting the player'.

label: Is obedient to
summary: Whether the character is obedient to the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in lists and portraits, where it is called with the overlord and combined with 'uses obedience'.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character that should be obeyed.

label: Is obscured
summary: A yes/no check on a character, named 'obscured'; the game documents nothing more.
details: The input shows no use, so what obscured means here is not known.

label: Is opposing
summary: Whether the character is opposing, as asked in the succession law change window.
details: Going by its name and its use in the succession change law window, where it shows one view when true and another when not. What exactly is opposed is read from that window only.

label: Is other liege or above
summary: Whether the character is a liege (or higher) other than the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the county window, where it is called with the player, and in one place used with a test that the character is not the player. The exact meaning is read from those uses only.

label: Is other player
summary: Whether the character is played by another human player (not the local one).
details: Going by its name and its use in the multiplayer lobby, where it is combined with 'is local player'.

label: Is part of player legacy
summary: Whether this character is part of the player legacy of the given character, going by the name.
details: The input shows no use in the base game and the game documents nothing more.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character whose player legacy is meant.

label: Is tenet change on cooldown
summary: Whether the character cannot change their personal tenets yet because of a cooldown.
details: Going by its name and its use in the personal beliefs window, where a button is enabled only when this is false.

label: Is pinned
summary: Whether the character is pinned in the outliner.
details: Vanilla uses it for the pin button: the text reads 'Unpin' when it is true and 'Pin' when not, and the button text says the character is kept track of in the outliner. The game does not register its return type.

label: Is player
summary: Whether the character is played by a human player.
details: Going by its name and its use in the outliner and in texts that choose a wording for players. Compare 'is local player', which is only the human on this computer.

label: Is interaction shown
summary: Whether the given player interaction is shown for this character.
details: Going by its name and its use in many windows (map icons, vassal detail, recruiting guests), where the interaction is given by its key, such as 'find_elder_interaction'.

label: Is interaction shown with title
summary: Whether the given interaction is shown for this character and a title can be picked for it.
details: Going by its name and its use in the vassal detail window, always called with an interaction key and a title.

label: Is interaction valid
summary: Whether the given player interaction is valid (can be done) with this character.
details: Going by its name and its use in many windows, where it decides if a button is enabled.

label: Is interaction valid for artifact
summary: Whether the given interaction is valid with this character and the given artifact as its target.
details: Going by its name and its use in the inventory window, where it enables the destroy-artifact button.

label: Is interaction valid for character
summary: Whether the given interaction is valid with this character and another character as its target.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. It looks like a sibling of the artifact and title versions.

label: Is interaction valid for secret
summary: Whether the given interaction is valid with this character and the given secret as its target.
details: Going by its name and its use in the intrigue window, where a negated check is used with the 'blackmail_interaction'.

label: Is interaction valid for title
summary: Whether the given interaction is valid with this character and the given title as its target.
details: Going by its name and its use in the vassal detail window, where it enables the candidacy buttons.

label: Is powerful vassal
summary: Whether the character is a powerful vassal.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window (paired with a vassal-of-overlord check) and in character lists.

label: Is puppet action shown
summary: Whether the given puppet action is shown for this character.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is puppet action valid
summary: Whether the given puppet action is valid for this character.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Puppet action description
summary: A text describing whether the given puppet action is valid.
details: Going by its name and its text return type: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Puppet action blockers
summary: A text listing only what blocks the given puppet action.
details: Going by its name and its text return type: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is puppet of
summary: Whether the character is a puppet of the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in portraits, where it is called with the player.

label: Is religious head
summary: Whether the character is a religious head.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window. The game does not register its return type, so this is read from how it is used.

label: Is ruler
summary: Whether the character is a ruler.
details: Going by its name and its use in texts and the character window. One text adds a low-key style to names of house members who are not rulers.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether the character is currently selected in the interface.
details: Going by its name and its use in portraits and the multiplayer lobby, it is an interface state, not a game fact.

label: Is shown in character window
summary: Whether this character is the one currently shown in the character window.
details: Vanilla uses it in tooltips: when true the hint reads 'Click to go to location', otherwise 'Click to view'. Its return type is not registered by the game.

label: Is fulfillment level active
summary: Whether the given level of the character's spiritual fulfillment is the active one.
details: Going by its name and its use in progress bars, where it is called with the bar item's index. In the personal beliefs texts, changing a tenet changes the character's spiritual fulfillment.

label: Is theocratic lessee
summary: Whether the character is a theocratic lessee.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character and realm windows, this is a yes/no check on a character.

label: Is theocratic lessee of
summary: Whether the character is a theocratic lessee of the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the council window, where it is called with the player.

label: Is traveling
summary: Whether the character is traveling.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD and portraits, where it shows or hides parts of the interface, sometimes only when the character has no running activity.

label: Is tributary of
summary: Whether the character is a tributary of the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in portraits, where it is called with the player.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether this points to a real character (there is one, not an empty slot).
details: Vanilla uses it to pick texts: an empty tax slot shows 'Empty' and an empty holder shows another message when it is false. It is used very widely.

label: Is vassal of
summary: Whether the character is a vassal of the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window, the map icons and the marriage window, where it is called with the player or the overlord.

label: Is visibly infertile
summary: Whether the character is visibly infertile.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. The game documents nothing more.

label: Knows doctrine
summary: Whether the character knows the given doctrine.
details: Going by its name only. The lines with the same name call it on the player in the faith window, with a doctrine type, to show a known or unknown label and to dim the entry; that is a hint at most.

label: Knows tenet
summary: Whether the character knows the given tenet.
details: Going by its name only. The lines with the same name call it on the player in the faith window, with a tenet type, to show a known or unknown label and to dim the entry; that is a hint at most.

label: Local player wording
summary: Gives the first text if the character is the local player, otherwise the second.
details: Vanilla uses it for grammar in activity texts: LocalPlayerString( 'are', 'is' ) writes 'are' for the local player and 'is' for anyone else.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The text for the local player.

label: Make scope
summary: Turns the character into a script scope, so script values and variables can be read from it.
details: Vanilla uses it in texts to reach variables saved on a character, for example Character.MakeScope.Var('movement_power') and a scope variable holding another character. It is used more than a thousand times.

label: Directly held counties
summary: The number of counties the character holds directly.
details: Vanilla uses it in the realm size tooltip, next to the realm size, under the heading about counties in the character's domain.

label: Customize portrait
summary: An action that opens the portrait customizing for the character.
details: Going by its name and its single use, a button click in the interaction menu window. It returns nothing.

label: On mouse enter
summary: An action that tells the game the mouse has entered this character's portrait or icon.
details: Going by its name and its use in portrait and map icon animation hooks (on_start and on_finish). It returns nothing.

label: On mouse leave
summary: An action that tells the game the mouse has left this character's portrait or icon.
details: Going by its name and its use in portrait and map icon animation hooks (on_start). It returns nothing.

label: Open declare war with artifact
summary: An action that opens the declare war view with an artifact as the cause.
details: Going by its name only. The lines with the same name call it on an artifact's owner in a button click in the inventory window, which is a hint at most. It returns nothing.

label: Open interaction
summary: An action that opens the given player interaction window with this character.
details: Going by its name and its use in button clicks across the HUD and vassal windows. It returns nothing.

label: Open interaction on artifact
summary: An action that opens the given interaction with an artifact as its target.
details: Going by its name and its use in the inventory window, with the destroy artifact interaction. It returns nothing.

label: Open interaction on character
summary: An action that opens the given interaction with another character as its target.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. It returns nothing.

label: Open interaction on secret
summary: An action that opens the given interaction with a secret as its target.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. It returns nothing.

label: Open interaction on title
summary: An action that opens the given interaction with a title as its target.
details: Going by its name and its use in the vassal detail window, with the candidacy and promote interactions. It returns nothing.

label: Open royal court view
summary: An action that opens the royal court view of the character, on the given part.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD and character window, always with 'throne'. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which part of the court view to open.

label: Pan camera to
summary: An action that moves the map camera to the character.
details: Going by its name and its use in button clicks in the interaction menu and government administration windows. It returns nothing.

label: Player can manage focus
summary: Whether the player can manage this character's focus.
details: Going by its name and its single use in the character window, where it is combined with a valid-focus check to decide if the focus part shows.

label: Player has hooks or secrets
summary: Whether the player has hooks on this character or secrets of theirs that could become hooks.
details: Going by its name and its use in lists and portraits, where it shows or hides something.

label: Player name
summary: The name of the human player who controls the character.
details: Vanilla uses it in tooltips such as 'This Character is controlled by ...' and in remarks that their behaviour is not affected by opinion and their obedience is unpredictable, because a human plays them.

label: Punishment tooltip
summary: The tooltip text about the punishment of this character.
details: Going by its name and its use as the tooltip of portraits. What exactly it says is not documented.

label: Realm size
summary: The size of the character's realm, as a number of counties.
details: Vanilla uses it in tooltips such as 'Realm Size: N counties'.

label: Remove from legend library
summary: A command that removes the given legend from the character's legend library.
details: Going by its name only. The lines with the same name call it on the player in the legend chronicle window inside PostCommand, IsValidCommand and GetCommandDesc (run, check and describe the command), which is a hint at most.

label: The character itself
summary: The character as an object, for passing to other functions.
details: Vanilla uses it as an argument, for example to compare two characters or to ask a trait name for this character. The game does not register its return type.

label: Send interaction
summary: An action that sends the given player interaction to this character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD: clicks that send gold-to-treasury interactions of different sizes (the amount depends on Ctrl and on the mouse button). It returns nothing.

label: Send interaction with option
summary: An action that sends the given interaction with a chosen option.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. It returns nothing.

label: Send interaction on title
summary: An action that sends the given interaction with a title as its target.
details: Going by its name only: the input shows no use. It returns nothing.

label: Set default raid intent
summary: A command that sets the character's default raid intent.
details: Going by its name and its use in the raid intent selection window, wrapped in PostCommand (run it) and IsValidCommand (enable the button).

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a raid intent type, e.g. RaidIntentData.GetType.Self

label: Set raid intent
summary: A command that sets the raid intent of the given army.
details: Going by its name and its use in the raid intent selection window, wrapped in PostCommand and IsValidCommand.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a raid intent type, e.g. RaidIntentData.GetType.Self

label: Costs use treasury
summary: Whether texts for the character use the monthly treasury wording in place of gold.
details: Vanilla uses it in texts: it picks a monthly-treasury prefix or a gold prefix for 'You have ...', and adds an extra line to the 'cannot declare war while in debt' messages.

label: Show dread effect icon
summary: Whether the dread effect icon should show for the character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the court positions window, always combined with a valid-character check.

label: Show dread icon for
summary: Whether the dread effect icon should show for the character towards the given character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window, where it is called with the liege or the court owner.

label: Show examination requirement
summary: Whether the examination requirement of the given merit rank should be shown.
details: Going by its name and its use in merit rank texts, where it is called with a number (3 in the lines given) and adds a text line when true.

label: Show legitimacy
summary: Whether legitimacy should be shown for the character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window and the ledger, where it is also paired with 'show merit' (one or the other).

label: Show merit
summary: Whether merit should be shown for the character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD, where it is combined with dynastic cycle checks.

label: Show movement power
summary: Whether movement power should be shown for the character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the HUD and portraits, where portraits also require the 'all_under_heaven' DLC feature.

label: Show radiance
summary: Whether radiance should be shown for the character.
details: Going by its name and its use in the character window and ledger, where a mandala government that does not show radiance gets another view.

label: Start council task in
summary: Starts the given council task in the given place.
details: Going by its name only. The one line with the same name calls it on the player in a button click with the task 'task_fabricate_claim' and a county's capital, which is a hint at most. The game does not register its return type.

label: Start planning great project
summary: A command that starts planning a great project of the given type in the given province.
details: Going by its name only. The lines with the same name call it on the planner of the plan great project window, inside PostCommand and IsValidCommand, which is a hint at most.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a great project type, e.g. GreatProjectType.Self

label: Start promoting legend
summary: A command that makes the character start promoting the given legend.
details: Going by its name and the legend texts: the button text says 'Start Legend' and there is a text for what blocks it. The lines with the same name call it on the player, which is a hint at most.

label: Stop promoting legend
summary: A command that makes the character stop promoting the given legend.
details: Going by its name only. The lines with the same name call it on the player in the legend chronicle window inside PostCommand, IsValidCommand and GetCommandDesc, which is a hint at most.
